notes: Production game source and assets; memory-only settings; no gameplay records sent.
All enemies must project inside the camera and have clear terrain line of sight. Other zombies may naturally overlap.
Player vertical physics is preserved; grounded state is not reset every frame. CPU section wrappers are diagnostic only.
Fixed positions run full enemy updates each frame. Chase repeats .8 second approaches with HG fire every .4s and durable enemies.
Real rAF intervals, CPU frame work and asynchronous GPU timer queries are reported separately.
Camera is held at consistent third-person framing; graphics follow the recorded quality preset. Diagnostic variants are tagged. Zombie model LOD is unchanged.
Background tabs or resizing invalidate a run.
